rule: Tasks whose outcomes were inspected before the current candidate freeze are regression fixtures, not untouched holdout. Every Skill needs a post-freeze, independently reviewed new task set before full-directory fresh acceptance can be claimed.
additional_requirement: Evidence-synthesis requires post-freeze tasks and an explicit composition evaluation; the seen handoff regression is not holdout and the two-call versus one-call compute difference must be disclosed.
generation_control: Keep existing pilot and rejection evidence unchanged. Create new attempt directories for post-freeze generation. Include optimization pilot prompts in the avoid set; current generator excludes optimization task sets, so this must be fixed before the supplemental generation.
browser_exception: Owner-approved parent authorship applies; new post-freeze tasks still require independent fixture review. Earlier parent tasks remain regression-only.
release_effect: No completely optimized claim from a mixture of pilot regression and untouched tasks presented as a single fresh holdout set.
